verdict.rationale: Tavily is a web API product, so API versioning and a deprecation policy are a fair question to ask. The evidence pack documents endpoints, SDKs, rate limits and MCP, but never mentions API version identifiers, versioned endpoints or a deprecation/sunset policy. The only related item is a single parameter option that keeps existing filter behavior, which is an adjacent backward-compatibility detail, not a versioning or deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
